title: Wide-angle lens — 300 mm f/1.8
description: The wide-angle lens is a camera lens specified here at 300 mm f/1.8. Lateral chromatic aberration: color fringing toward the frame edges. Coma: point highlights smear into teardrop shapes at wide apertures. Needs no chromatic correction: reflectors focus all colors together. Typical use: architectural photography.
